Name: Donut's Lantana's Anime Portrait Redesign
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
This Mod is meant to be used with the redesigned sprite of Lantana made by playerlyf: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23781]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23781
[/url]
I personally found the base lantana sprite jarring to look at as it was definitely different than all other sprites in-game, haha. So I took this redrawn sprite and  then made a Anime Version for it. Hopefully If there are any Poly-Sweet mod users they'll also enjoy this as well!

Downloads.Description: Just throw unzipped contents into mod folder in order to change the portrait.
